# IQ*_K BYTE-EXACT GOLDEN VECTORS -- generated by tests/test-iqk-golden.cpp
#
# WHAT EACH COLUMN IS:
#   name    ggml type name
#   qhash   FNV-1a 64 over the RAW QUANTIZED BYTES produced by from_float_ref
#   dhash   FNV-1a 64 over the DEQUANTIZED FLOAT BITS produced by to_float
#   qbytes  ggml_row_size(type, 4096)
#
# from_float_ref is the ARCHITECTURE-INDEPENDENT reference path, deliberately not the SIMD
# from_float, so these numbers stay valid on a host with different vector extensions.
#
# WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR: any reimplementation of the IQ*_K quants -- a Rust port, another backend,
# or a refactor of the C -- must reproduce every number here exactly. A tolerance test passes a
# close-but-different implementation and lets it silently degrade every model that uses it; byte
# equality is the only bar a reimplementation can be held to.
#
# WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT: proof the quants are CORRECT. It freezes current behaviour so CHANGE is
# detectable. If the C is wrong today, these numbers are wrong in exactly the same way.
#
# Generated on the mingw g++ / GGML_CUDA=OFF tree (build-static). CPU reference path only; no
# GPU kernel is exercised and none is pinned by this file.
